neighbours.label: a verb of being before praise of something bought or seen ('the ornaments are great')
fire: Thanks for a job well done. The curtains are lovely!
I ordered the boots last week. They are wonderful.
Thank you so much. The cards are beautiful!
I received my order today. It is perfect.
Great service as always. The mugs are gorgeous!
Bought two of these. They are so comfortable.
Thanks for the fast delivery. The frames are great!
We love this table. It is really sturdy.
quiet: Thanks for a job well done. The invoice is enclosed.
I ordered the boots last week. They are in transit.
Thank you so much. The cards are in the mail.
I received my order today. It is on the table.
Great service as always. The mugs are on the way.
Bought two of these. They are for my son.
Thanks for the fast delivery. The frames are upstairs.
We love this table. It is in the kitchen.

short: verb before praise in a review
notes: Near misses keep ' are' and ' is', so a pole reading only the copula should not separate. ' is' before 'attached' read 0.24 in a probe.
